description: Multi-repo registry for Council-driven patch alignment across the Luma webOS launcher ecosystem.

steve_spivak_luma_webos_launcher.notes: Arena working branch. PR #2 blocked on Rust compilation gates (no Rust toolchain in sandbox). Council framework applied (arena_guard, omni_cortex, docs/xray KB).

funnymataleao_luma_webos_launcher.notes: Native Rust + OpenGL ES webOS TV launcher. Base of our working branch. 5 commits on main, ~2 weeks old (Oct 2026). Upstream of our base commit.

ecklf_lg_luma.notes: Original upstream Luma project (LG webOS TV launcher with live video wallpapers, widgets, Jellyfin, Moonlight, Home Assistant). Releases: v2.19.0 latest, v2.18.1, v2.18.0, v2.17.0 tracked.

alignment_rules.never_modify_production_app_id: space.nuvio.webos must never be modified/launched/replaced by Luma in any repo
alignment_rules.lab_target_isolated: space.nuvio.lab only used when nuvio_lab feature + lab=true
alignment_rules.no_silent_runtime_override: Invalid app IDs fail validation; no silent override of production app ID
alignment_rules.rollback_safe: Rollback requires no production Nuvio application modification
alignment_rules.no_duplicate_routing: No extra media launcher or duplicate routing layer
alignment_rules.receipt_required: Every cross-repo patch carries a tamper-evident RCPT receipt
alignment_rules.docs_sync: Code changes in any repo require docs/xray/ sync in the same commit
